Recovery: "She wasn't ... yes, 'pitying' again then. We were two people talking together on equal terms, not prisoner and jailer. She was simply so fantastic ... and it was as if I could talk with her without feeling that, – what shall I say – she would not divert the conversation, no matter what." [page/7/Text/6]
